Strategy: Soften the item-scaled penalty to a quarter item while keeping the half-item reward, testing whether a gentler sliver penalty improves on the current best. It may help by punishing slivers less harshly, but may fail if the penalty was doing real work.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item / 2 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (item / 4 if r - item >= 6 and r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
